releases.body:
## Fixes
- Skip unsupported projects before recursive file traversal, hashing, or checker execution.
- Probe only root metadata once per genuine user request; newly added typecheck support activates on the next request.
- Preserve configuration-error reporting and existing supported-project safety checks.

## Verification
- Typecheck and all 40 automated tests pass.
- Playground typecheck passes.
- Release archive contents, disposable installation, and plugin import verified.

Initial release of opencode-ts-typecheck: automatic TypeScript checking and bounded agent repair for OpenCode 2.4.1. Runs the project's typecheck script or falls back to tsc --noEmit. Uses the experimental pre-completion hook.
